coorong-national-park-4.name: Nukan Kungun Hike
coorong-national-park-4.bio: Two-day, 25 km walk from Salt Creek to 42 Mile Crossing that links the park's best-known trails.

notes.pin: Route midpoint, Salt Creek to 42 Mile Crossing Campground (about 25 km); not in the draft with coordinates. Use OSM hiking route if present, else the NPWS trail map. Camping at 42 Mile Crossing is charged separately (from $12.30 per night per park page); the walk itself has no fee.

coorong-national-park-5.name: Godfrey's Landing
coorong-national-park-5.bio: Storm Boy filming location on the Younghusband Peninsula, reached by boat, with a 3 km dune walk to the ocean beach.

notes.pin: Landing and jetty on the Coorong lagoon edge at the start of the 3 km Godfrey's Landing Walk; boat/kayak access only, from Goolwa or Hindmarsh Island. Pin the landing, not the ocean beach.

coorong-national-park-6.name: Parnka Point
coorong-national-park-6.bio: The narrowest point between the Coorong's two lagoons, known as Hells Gate, with lagoon views and wading birds.

notes.pin: Parnka Point car park, toilets and boat ramp (NPWS accessible car park listed). Parnka Ngoppun Trail (5 km loop) starts here.

coorong-national-park-7.name: Chinaman's Well Historic Site
coorong-national-park-7.bio: Stone well and old quarries from the gold-rush era, seen on the one-hour, 1.3 km Journey to Gold Walk.

notes.pin: Chinaman's Well car park / trailhead; the walk is a 1.3 km return so the well itself is within about 650 m of it.

coorong-national-park-8.name: Lakes Nature Walk
coorong-national-park-8.bio: Easy 3 km loop of about an hour past ephemeral lakes and mallee scrub.

notes.pin: Loop Road (Lakes Nature Trail car park) per NPWS accessibility list. Loop: pin at the loop's middle or car park if the route is not in OSM.

coorong-national-park-9.name: Ngrugie Ngoppun Walk
coorong-national-park-9.bio: Easy 2.5 km loop of about an hour and a quarter, with wildlife viewing and local history.

notes.pin: Trailhead per NPWS trail map; loop of 2.5 km (1 hr 15 min). Check it is not the same trailhead as Parnka Ngoppun Trail or Lakes Nature Walk.

coorong-national-park-10.name: Raukkan Church
coorong-national-park-10.bio: The 1868 church at Raukkan that is pictured on the $50 note, in a Ngarrindjeri community that welcomes visitors.

notes.pin: Raukkan Church building itself (OSM place_of_worship / Wikipedia Raukkan Church photo). Keep 25 m+ from the Raukkan community pin (coorong-national-park-11) per pin-shared rule.

coorong-national-park-10.ticket_note: No separate official site found for the church; the community's own site (raukkan.com) failed to load, so no ticketUrl is given.

coorong-national-park-11.name: Raukkan
coorong-national-park-11.bio: Ngarrindjeri community on the shore of Lake Alexandrina with a museum and the church on the $50 note.

notes.pin: Draft pin (-35.506, 139.135) is three decimals, so a memory-grade pin; redo from the OSM place point for Raukkan (about 4.5 km west of Narrung). Must sit 25 m+ from the church pin.

coorong-national-park-11.ticket_note: Raukkan community site (raukkan.com) failed to load; verify the official visitor page in a browser.

coorong-national-park-12.name: Point Malcolm Lighthouse
coorong-national-park-12.bio: Australia's only inland lighthouse, built in 1878 above the narrows between Lake Albert and Lake Alexandrina.

notes.pin: Lighthouse on the cliff on the east side of the narrows, north of Poltalloch Rd, just above the Narrung ferry landing (Wikipedia/OSM man_made=lighthouse).

coorong-national-park-12.ticket_note: Council-owned roadside landmark; no official visitor page found.

coorong-national-park-13.name: Pink Lake
coorong-national-park-13.bio: Pink-tinged salt lake near Meningie, a photo stop on the Narrung and Lake Albert scenic loop.

notes.pin: Pink Lake beside the Princes Highway near Meningie (OSM natural=water named Pink Lake); the lake has no Wikipedia article of its own, so no wiki field. Draft name 'Pink Lake (Meningie)' renamed per no-qualifier rule.

coorong-national-park-13.ticket_note: Roadside lake with no steward; no official site.

coorong-national-park-14.name: Lake Albert
coorong-national-park-14.bio: Shallow lake beside Meningie where visitors swim, fish and watch the sunset.

notes.pin: Meningie lakefront / jetty on Lake Albert (town foreshore), not the lake centroid (it is in water). Pin at the public foreshore access point.

coorong-national-park-14.ticket_note: Open lake with no single steward.

coorong-national-park-15.name: Bushranger Birdman of the Coorong
coorong-national-park-15.bio: Life-size saddled ostrich statue on the Meningie lake shore that tells the Peggotty legend.

notes.pin: Statue on the Meningie foreshore of Lake Albert; take the point from OSM tourism=artwork or the SATC attraction geotag.

coorong-national-park-15.ticket_note: Council foreshore sculpture; no official site.
